articles.title: Ohio Becomes a Midterm Battleground Again
articles.summary: Ohio's races for governor and U.S. Senate are toss-ups, as voters weigh the cost of living before Election Day.

articles.title: A Giant Hidden Ocean Wave Is Raising Sea Levels on the West Coast
articles.summary: A slow, hidden ocean wave linked to El Niño is raising sea levels on the West Coast, and more are expected.

articles.title: Paris Sets Curfews After Weekend of Protests and Rioting
articles.summary: Paris and other French cities set curfews after weekend protests about living costs and school conditions turned into rioting.
